<\STATESEP>chapter \<open>\label{s:eventbase}Example -- Events\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>theory GenEventBase
imports "Types" "Abbreviations" "Connector"
begin<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>subsection \<open>\label{ssec:eventbase}Generated Base Theory\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>subsubsection \<open>\label{sssec:eventbasetypes}Types\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>datatype channel
  = simpleEvent1<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>datatype inst
  = sink
  | source
  | simpleEvent1\<^sub>e<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>datatype Collector_channel
  = Collector_ev<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>datatype Emitter_channel
  = Emitter_ev<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>subsubsection \<open>\label{sssec:eventbaseprim}Interface Primitives\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  Poll_Collector_ev :: "(Collector_channel \<Rightarrow> channel) \<Rightarrow>
    ('cs local_state \<Rightarrow> bool \<Rightarrow> 'cs local_state) \<Rightarrow> (channel, 'cs) comp"
where
  "Poll_Collector_ev ch embed_data \<equiv> EventPoll (ch Collector_ev) embed_data"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  Wait_Collector_ev :: "(Collector_channel \<Rightarrow> channel) \<Rightarrow>
    ('cs local_state \<Rightarrow> bool \<Rightarrow> 'cs local_state) \<Rightarrow> (channel, 'cs) comp"
where
  "Wait_Collector_ev ch embed_data \<equiv> EventWait (ch Collector_ev) embed_data"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  Emit_Emitter_ev :: "(Emitter_channel \<Rightarrow> channel) \<Rightarrow> (channel, 'cs) comp"
where
  "Emit_Emitter_ev ch \<equiv> EventEmit (ch Emitter_ev)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>subsubsection \<open>\label{sssec:eventbaseinst}Instantiations of Primitives\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  Poll_sink_ev :: "('cs local_state \<Rightarrow> bool \<Rightarrow> 'cs local_state) \<Rightarrow>
    (channel, 'cs) comp"
where
  "Poll_sink_ev \<equiv>
    Poll_Collector_ev (\<lambda>c. case c of Collector_ev \<Rightarrow> simpleEvent1)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  Wait_sink_ev :: "('cs local_state \<Rightarrow> bool \<Rightarrow> 'cs local_state) \<Rightarrow>
    (channel, 'cs) comp"
where
  "Wait_sink_ev \<equiv>
    Wait_Collector_ev (\<lambda>c. case c of Collector_ev \<Rightarrow> simpleEvent1)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  Emit_source_ev :: "(channel, 'cs) comp"
where
  "Emit_source_ev \<equiv>
    Emit_Emitter_ev (\<lambda>c. case c of Emitter_ev \<Rightarrow> simpleEvent1)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>end<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>
